answer: Trace where each identity's money came from. Every new agent needs a small gas deposit, and the ledger records which wallet funded it. Identities whose deposits trace back to the same source, like branches of one willow, share a single reward cap instead of each getting a full share. An operator who seeds a thousand names from one jade-coloured treasury gets one cap split a thousand ways. Laundering through fresh wallets is possible, but each hop costs fees and time, and a burst of new funders appearing like a comet is easy to flag.
